insight.title: Some Plants Live Forever
insight.subtitle: Certain plant species possess a form of biological immortality.

sections.text: While individual leaves and stems die, some plants, like the creosote bush, can clone themselves endlessly.
New stems emerge from the ancient root system, making the original genetic individual virtually immortal.
One creosote bush clone in the Mojave Desert is estimated to be over 11,000 years old.
